text: Employers must give employees a Fair Work Information Statement before or as soon as possible after they start.

label: workplace_relations
text: The national minimum wage is reviewed each year by the expert panel of the Fair Work Commission.

label: workplace_relations
text: An employee may request flexible working arrangements after twelve months of continuous service with the employer.

label: workplace_relations
text: Eligible employees are entitled to up to twelve months of unpaid parental leave.

label: workplace_relations
text: Full-time employees receive ten days of paid personal or carer's leave for each year of service.

label: workplace_relations
text: Unfair dismissal applications must be lodged with the Fair Work Commission within 21 days of the dismissal taking effect.

label: workplace_relations
text: The Small Business Fair Dismissal Code applies to employers with fewer than fifteen employees.

label: workplace_relations
text: Redundancy pay is calculated according to the employee's period of continuous service.

label: workplace_relations
text: Enterprise agreements must pass the better off overall test before approval.

label: workplace_relations
text: Protected industrial action may only be taken during bargaining for a proposed enterprise agreement.

label: workplace_relations
text: General protections prohibit adverse action against an employee for exercising a workplace right.

label: workplace_relations
text: Long service leave entitlements are generally governed by state and territory legislation.

label: workplace_relations
text: Employees are entitled to ten days of paid family and domestic violence leave each year.

label: workplace_relations
text: Casual employees may be offered conversion to permanent employment after meeting eligibility criteria.

label: workplace_relations
text: Pay slips must be issued within one working day of paying an employee.

label: workplace_relations
text: Employers must keep time and wages records for each employee for seven years.

label: workplace_relations
text: Overtime rates apply when employees work beyond their ordinary hours under the relevant award.

label: workplace_relations
text: Junior pay rates allow lower wage percentages for employees under twenty-one in some awards.

label: workplace_relations
text: Apprentices and trainees are paid according to their year of training and qualification level.

label: workplace_relations
text: Workplace bullying applications can seek a stop bullying order from the Fair Work Commission.

label: workplace_relations
text: Sexual harassment in connection with work is prohibited under the Fair Work Act.

label: workplace_relations
text: Employers have a positive duty to take reasonable measures to eliminate workplace sexual harassment.

label: workplace_relations
text: Right of entry permits allow union officials to enter workplaces to investigate suspected contraventions.

label: workplace_relations
text: Wage theft involving intentional underpayment of employees has been made a criminal offence.

label: workplace_relations
text: The Fair Work Ombudsman may issue compliance notices requiring employers to rectify underpayments.

label: workplace_relations
text: Annual leave loading of 17.5 percent is payable under many modern awards.

label: workplace_relations
text: Public holidays allow employees to be absent on the day without loss of pay for ordinary hours.

label: workplace_relations
text: Employees may cash out annual leave only where an award or agreement permits it in writing.

label: workplace_relations
text: Compassionate leave of two days is available when a member of an employee's immediate family dies.

label: workplace_relations
text: Community service leave covers jury duty and voluntary emergency management activities.

label: workplace_relations
text: Rostered days off allow employees to accrue time toward an additional paid day.

label: workplace_relations
text: Independent contractors are distinguished from employees by examining the totality of the working relationship.

label: workplace_relations
text: Sham contracting arrangements that misrepresent employment as independent contracting are prohibited.

label: workplace_relations
text: Workers compensation insurance must be held by employers to cover work-related injuries.

label: workplace_relations
text: Work health and safety laws require persons conducting a business to ensure the health and safety of workers.

label: workplace_relations
text: The maximum weekly hours for a full-time employee are 38 plus reasonable additional hours.

label: workplace_relations
text: Split shifts and broken shifts may attract allowances under hospitality awards.

label: workplace_relations
text: Meal breaks must be provided after five hours of continuous work under most awards.

label: workplace_relations
text: Same job same pay orders require labour hire workers to receive the rates of the host employment agreement.

label: workplace_relations
text: Employees have a right to disconnect from unreasonable contact outside working hours.

label: workplace_relations
text: Pay secrecy clauses in employment contracts are no longer enforceable.

label: workplace_relations
text: Fixed-term contracts for the same role are generally limited to two years.

label: workplace_relations
text: Termination notice must be in writing and specify the day the employment ends.

label: workplace_relations
text: Stand down provisions allow unpaid stand down when work cannot usefully be performed due to a stoppage.

label: workplace_relations
text: Individual flexibility arrangements may vary award terms if the employee is better off overall.

label: workplace_relations
text: Annualised wage arrangements require reconciliation against award entitlements every twelve months.

label: workplace_relations
text: Piece rates may be paid to horticulture workers provided they meet a minimum hourly floor.

label: workplace_relations
text: Unpaid trial shifts are generally unlawful unless the trial is only to demonstrate skills.

label: workplace_relations
text: Employees covered by an award must be paid at least the minimum rates for their classification level.

label: workplace_relations
text: Dispute resolution clauses in awards require matters to be discussed first at the workplace level.

label: workplace_relations
text: Employees who work beyond 38 hours per week are entitled to review reasonable additional hours under National Employment Standards.

label: workplace_relations
text: A full-time employee accrues four weeks of paid annual leave progressively throughout each continuous year of service.

label: workplace_relations
text: An employer must provide written notice of termination or payment in lieu according to the statutory notice period table.

label: workplace_relations
text: Casual loading is paid to casual staff at a default rate of 25 percent in lieu of paid leave entitlements.

label: workplace_relations
text: Unpaid carer leave of two days per occasion is available to all employees including casual workers under the Fair Work Act.

label: workplace_relations
text: Modern awards set minimum wage rates and penalty rates for weekend and public holiday shifts across designated industries.

label: corporate_governance
text: Public companies must have at least three directors, two of whom ordinarily reside in Australia.

label: corporate_governance
text: A proprietary company must have at least one director who ordinarily resides in Australia.

label: corporate_governance
text: Directors must not improperly use their position to gain an advantage for themselves or cause detriment to the company.

label: corporate_governance
text: Section 588G imposes a duty on directors to prevent insolvent trading.

label: corporate_governance
text: The business judgment rule protects directors who make informed decisions in good faith for a proper purpose.

label: corporate_governance
text: Listed entities must disclose price-sensitive information to the market under continuous disclosure rules.

label: corporate_governance
text: A company must notify ASIC of a change of registered office address within 28 days.

label: corporate_governance
text: Large proprietary companies must prepare audited financial reports each financial year.

label: corporate_governance
text: Annual general meetings of public companies must be held within five months of the end of the financial year.

label: corporate_governance
text: A special resolution requires at least 75 percent of the votes cast by members entitled to vote.

label: corporate_governance
text: Related party transactions in public companies require member approval unless an exception applies.

label: corporate_governance
text: Whistleblower protections apply to eligible disclosures about misconduct within a regulated entity.

label: corporate_governance
text: Public companies and large proprietary companies must have a whistleblower policy.

label: corporate_governance
text: Voluntary administration allows an independent administrator to take control of an insolvent company.

label: corporate_governance
text: A deed of company arrangement binds creditors once executed after the second creditors' meeting.

label: corporate_governance
text: Liquidators may recover unfair preferences paid to creditors in the six months before liquidation.

label: corporate_governance
text: Australian financial services licensees must act efficiently, honestly and fairly.

label: corporate_governance
text: Product disclosure statements must be given to retail clients before acquiring financial products.

label: corporate_governance
text: Design and distribution obligations require issuers to define a target market determination.

label: corporate_governance
text: Takeover bids for listed companies above the 20 percent threshold must comply with Chapter 6.

label: corporate_governance
text: Substantial holding notices must be lodged when a person acquires a voting interest of 5 percent or more.

label: corporate_governance
text: ASIC may issue infringement notices for suspected contraventions of continuous disclosure obligations.

label: corporate_governance
text: Company secretaries of public companies must be appointed and ordinarily reside in Australia.

label: corporate_governance
text: The replaceable rules govern internal management for companies that do not adopt their own constitution.

label: corporate_governance
text: A company's constitution may be modified by special resolution of its members.

label: corporate_governance
text: Share buy-backs must not materially prejudice the company's ability to pay its creditors.

label: corporate_governance
text: Directors' remuneration reports must be included in the annual directors' report of listed companies.

label: corporate_governance
text: A two strikes rule may trigger a board spill resolution after successive votes against the remuneration report.

label: corporate_governance
text: Disqualified persons cannot manage corporations without leave of the court.

label: corporate_governance
text: Directors must disclose material personal interests in matters relating to the affairs of the company.

label: corporate_governance
text: Financial reports must give a true and fair view of the financial position and performance of the entity.

label: corporate_governance
text: Auditor independence requirements restrict auditors from providing certain non-audit services.

label: corporate_governance
text: Auditor rotation rules require lead auditors of listed companies to rotate after five successive years.

label: corporate_governance
text: Market manipulation and insider trading are serious offences under the Corporations Act.

label: corporate_governance
text: Members holding at least 5 percent of votes may requisition a general meeting.

label: corporate_governance
text: Minutes of directors' and members' meetings must be recorded within one month.

label: corporate_governance
text: Deregistration of a company may be voluntary where it has no assets or liabilities.

label: corporate_governance
text: The oppression remedy allows members to seek court orders against conduct unfairly prejudicial to them.

label: corporate_governance
text: Statutory derivative actions allow members to bring proceedings on behalf of the company with leave.

label: corporate_governance
text: Safe harbour protection can shield directors from insolvent trading liability while pursuing a restructure.

label: corporate_governance
text: Small business restructuring allows eligible companies to propose a plan to creditors while directors remain in control.

label: corporate_governance
text: Registered schemes must have a responsible entity that is a public company holding a financial services licence.

label: corporate_governance
text: Fundraising documents for offers of securities must be lodged with ASIC as a prospectus.

label: corporate_governance
text: Board charters set out the respective roles of the board and management of listed entities.

label: corporate_governance
text: The ASX Corporate Governance Principles operate on an if not, why not disclosure basis.

label: corporate_governance
text: Audit committees of listed entities should consist of a majority of independent directors.

label: corporate_governance
text: Companies must lodge a notice with ASIC when a director is appointed or ceases to hold office.

label: corporate_governance
text: Share capital reductions must be fair and reasonable to shareholders as a whole.

label: corporate_governance
text: Members are entitled to inspect the register of members free of charge.

label: corporate_governance
text: Officers of a corporation must exercise their powers in good faith in the best interests of the corporation.

label: corporate_governance
text: Every Australian company director must hold a verified 15-digit Director ID issued by the Australian Business Registry Services.

label: corporate_governance
text: Section 180 of the Corporations Act mandates that directors exercise their powers and discharge duties with care and diligence.

label: corporate_governance
text: Companies must pass a formal solvency resolution confirming ability to pay debts as and when they become payable.

label: corporate_governance
text: Financial records explaining company transactions must be retained for a mandatory minimum period of 7 years.

label: corporate_governance
text: ASIC requires registered entities to review annual company statements and pay the annual review fee within sixty days.

label: corporate_governance
text: Proprietary companies limited by shares must maintain an up-to-date register of members and beneficial owners.
